subtopics.lesson_title: Building Blocks of Python and Django
subtopics.subtopic_description: Explore fundamental Python data types such as integers, floats, strings, and booleans. Dive into basic arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators. Learn how to use these in simple expressions and statements.
subtopics.co: Understand the basics of Python and Django frameworks

subtopics.lesson_title: Building Blocks of Python and Django
subtopics.subtopic_description: Explore the MVT architecture in Django, including the role of models, views, and templates. Understand how to define models in Django, create views to handle HTTP requests, and configure templates for rendering the final output. Dive into the basics of Django’s ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) and how to interact with databases using models.
subtopics.co: Understand the basics of Python and Django frameworks

subtopics.subtopic_description: Explore advanced model fields (e.g., ManyToManyField, ManyToManyField through intermediary models) and complex relationships.
subtopics.co: Understand the basics of Python and Django frameworks

subtopics.subtopic_title: Optimizing Views and Templates for Performance
subtopics.subtopic_description: Learn techniques to optimize view and template performance, including caching, lazy loading, and efficient template rendering.
subtopics.co: Understand the basics of Python and Django frameworks
